entries.title: Work your first mate started on its own no longer shows another task's message as "You asked"
entries.body: When your first mate starts a fix on its own after a crewmate's report, its cards now read "From" the task it came from, instead of quoting the message you wrote for that other task.
entries.noPicture: The From line looks as it always has; only which line a first-mate-started change shows is different.
